tasks.title: Call the Galveston County Court Coordinator (212th District)
tasks.alert_text: Call 212th Coordinator for Cause No. 25-FD-1502. Ask if Judge Grady will sign the Clarification Order on operation of law (written submission) to unmask the blank 'Minors' section before the June 24 Brazoria deadline.

tasks.title: Call the Brazoria County Court Coordinator (461st District)
tasks.alert_text: Call 461st Coordinator for Cause No. 135860-F. Confirm receipt of the Motion for Continuance, Formal Objections, and Notice of Galveston Proceedings. Request that the Judge withhold signing the Petitioner's 26-page draft order.

tasks.title: Serve Notice of Hearing on Jessica
tasks.alert_text: Forward the June 24 Notice of Hearing to Jessica to satisfy the court's verification rule. Save the sent receipt!

tasks.title: Check Portal for 'Filing Accepted' Statuses
tasks.alert_text: Log into the Texas E-Filing portal to verify that both the Galveston Clerk and Brazoria Clerk have officially approved and file-stamped all your new documents.

tasks.title: Weekly Status Check-In (Galveston)
tasks.alert_text: Polled Galveston 1 week ago. Call back to check if Judge Grady has reviewed the proposed Clarification Order on the pleadings.

tasks.title: Mid-Point Status Check-In (Galveston)
tasks.alert_text: Polled Galveston 2 weeks ago. Call back to check status. Emphasize that the Brazoria court deadline is now less than two weeks away.

phase: Phase 3: The Fork in the Road

tasks.title: [IF SCENARIO A] Galveston Order is Signed
action_steps: Download the signed, file-marked copy from the Galveston portal.
E-file a brief 'Notice of Filing Out-of-County Order' in Brazoria County, uploading this signed document behind it as an exhibit.
Call the Brazoria coordinator to say: 'The Galveston judge has officially clarified the order. It is now on file in Brazoria for the Judge's review.'
tasks.alert_text: Galveston Judge signs the Clarification Order before June 15.

tasks.title: [IF SCENARIO B] Prepare for Motion for Continuance Ruling
action_steps: Call the Brazoria coordinator specifically about your pending Motion for Continuance.
Ask if the Judge will rule on the continuance from the bench prior to June 24th, or if you need to appear on June 24th solely to present the continuance request.
tasks.alert_text: Galveston is still pending by Monday, June 15, 2026.

tasks.title: Hearing Date – 461st District Court (Brazoria)

required_physical_assets: Printed copy of your Motion for New Trial and Formal Objections.
Printed screenshot of the email proving you served Jessica with the notice (Task 3).
Either the signed Galveston Order (Scenario A) OR a copy of your Galveston motion file-stamp proving the clarification is still active and pending (Scenario B).

tasks.alert_text: Wednesday, June 24, 2026, at 9:00 AM. 111 E. Locust, Angleton, Texas 77515 (4th Floor, Room 452.010).
